# Synthetic secret-detection corpus. One shape per line, one format per shape.
# Lines are templates: {alnum:N}, {hex:N}, {upper:N}, {digits:N}, {b32:N},
# {bech32:N}, {b64:N} are expanded in memory by expand_sample() when the test
# runs. No complete token shape is ever stored in the repository, so secret
# scanners and push protection never see one. Nothing here is a real credential.
